name: search_code
description: Search the project source. Input: {"engine": "rg" | "ast-grep" | "semcode", "query": "...", "path": "."}. rg = ripgrep regex search (--json); ast-grep = structural AST pattern search; semcode = semantic code search (needs a .semcode.db). Returns {"ok": bool, "code": int, "stdout": "...", "stderr": "..."}.
